ov: An antelope of the Central Asian steppes with a swollen, downward-pointing nose. It migrates in huge herds across Kazakhstan, Russia and Mongolia. Hunting for its horns and mass die-offs cut numbers by 95%, but it has since made a remarkable recovery.

why.et: Hunted for meat, which is compared to lamb; hunting reopened in Kazakhstan in 2025.

rg: Steppes of Kazakhstan and Russia's Kalmykia and Astrakhan regions, wintering into Uzbekistan, plus western Mongolia.
df: Many steppe plants, including some that are poisonous to other animals.
fx: In May 2015 over 120,000 died within weeks, killed by a normally harmless bacterium, probably triggered by warm, wet weather.
Kazakhstan's saigas grew from about 21,000 in 2003 to an estimated 3.9 million adults in 2025.
